repos.name: agent-world
repos.desc: Pixel-art world where my repos' agents live and work, driven by real activity

commits.msg: Site checks never hold the picture up: wait a moment for them on first load, apply late answers when they arrive, ignore them while the browser is offline
commits.author: venturinodino-creator

commits.msg: Watch the four Research CRM websites: an island each, working while the site answers, failing when it does not
commits.author: venturinodino-creator

commits.msg: Work button on every card of an agent that is not working: sign-in prompt for viewers, real start for the Admin, a note on agents that cannot be started
commits.author: venturinodino-creator

commits.msg: Crowded islands swap only the tall silo, hangar and water tower for low buildings, so the rest keep their look; pin where shrinking starts
commits.author: venturinodino-creator

commits.msg: Review fixes: island crowding no longer depends on the other repos, one tested crowdLook rule, sparks follow smaller roofs, fuel sphere no longer pierced by a floodlight, README matches
commits.author: venturinodino-creator

commits.msg: Declutter crowded islands: half-size flatter buildings, bare free tiles and slightly bigger astronauts, so the agents stand out
commits.author: venturinodino-creator

commits.msg: Taller central rocket with no landing legs or gantry, and smaller buildings on crowded islands so the astronauts stay in view
commits.author: venturinodino-creator

commits.msg: Central rocket: plate seams, fairing ring, conduits, nozzle cluster, a service gantry with swing arms, floodlights and fuel spheres
commits.author: venturinodino-creator

commits.msg: Clean up: remove dead code and unused exports, one line ending (LF), README and glossary rewritten to match, a message when the graphics card drops the 3D view, favicon and meta
commits.author: venturinodino-creator

commits.msg: Manager overview: totals, one-line verdict, agents needing attention and a status bar per repo, worst first
commits.author: venturinodino-creator

commits.msg: Every island gets its own design: seven different bases and seven floor patterns
commits.author: venturinodino-creator

commits.msg: Only two states: agents at work carry items to the base, every other agent lies asleep with a zzz, nobody wanders about
commits.author: venturinodino-creator

commits.msg: Working agents keep picking things up and carrying them to the base in the middle of their hexagon
commits.author: venturinodino-creator

commits.msg: Agents on a timer jog between runs, agents with no timer lie asleep with a zzz, working ones keep hammering
commits.author: venturinodino-creator

commits.msg: Drop plumbing workflows, show every non-working agent asleep and working ones clearly at work, thin the solid decor on crowded islands
commits.author: venturinodino-creator

commits.msg: Helmets in the suit colour and bigger astronauts, so they stand out from the buildings
commits.author: venturinodino-creator

commits.msg: Much bigger base in the middle of each hexagon, with room around it
commits.author: venturinodino-creator

commits.msg: Bigger rocket in the centre and bigger buildings and bases, with a little more room between tiles
commits.author: venturinodino-creator

commits.msg: Bigger astronauts and buildings, and a much bigger base in the middle of each hexagon, with more room around it
commits.author: venturinodino-creator

commits.msg: Colour the astronauts so they stand out from the buildings, bigger buildings, sharper rendering (higher resolution cap, bigger shadow map, more reflection, sharper textures)
commits.author: venturinodino-creator

commits.msg: Frame the whole world in narrow windows: back the camera off until every island edge is inside the free part of the view
commits.author: venturinodino-creator

commits.msg: Astronauts about 40% bigger, buildings fill their tiles, islands packed tighter with a closer camera
commits.author: venturinodino-creator

commits.msg: Bigger buildings and astronauts on wider tiles; nine habitat types, a new rocket, and decor from the reference sheet; sharper textures
commits.author: venturinodino-creator

commits.msg: Larger buildings, headquarters and astronauts, with wider tiles to fit them and a tighter default view
commits.author: venturinodino-creator

commits.msg: One astronaut per agent: remove the walking crew
commits.author: venturinodino-creator

commits.msg: Replace the central radio tower with a rocket on a landing pad, in the same style as Claude's
commits.author: venturinodino-creator

commits.msg: Only crystals and plants on the flat ground: remove the rock spires and floating rocks
commits.author: venturinodino-creator

commits.msg: Flatten the landscape (heights off, colours kept) and restore the original camera angle
commits.author: venturinodino-creator

commits.msg: Alien planet: coloured terrain with canyons and glowing cracks, crystals, spires and luminous plants, nebula sky with a ringed gas giant
commits.author: venturinodino-creator

commits.msg: Moon-base setting: habitat domes, tubes, silos, rocket, rover, cabin, dishes and a lattice tower on a cratered lunar surface under a starry sky
commits.author: venturinodino-creator

commits.msg: Turn the agents and the walking crew into astronauts: white suits, round helmets with glass visors, backpacks and coloured trim
commits.author: venturinodino-creator

commits.msg: Cut per-frame load: 70% fewer triangles, half the draw calls (static buildings merged, lighter geometry)
commits.author: venturinodino-creator

commits.msg: Smoother render (AO only up close, FXAA, adaptive resolution, half-rate workers, no redundant rebuilds) and more realistic faces, fabric and sand
commits.author: venturinodino-creator

commits.msg: Activate: Admin can start a workflow from its card, and the world follows the run
commits.author: venturinodino-creator

commits.msg: Add the glossary and the decision to activate through a server-held token
commits.author: venturinodino-creator

commits.msg: Show zzz only on agents that are really asleep or idle
commits.author: venturinodino-creator

commits.msg: Show a bold zzz over every agent that is not working
commits.author: venturinodino-creator

commits.msg: Smooth the render: merge models into few draw calls, half-res effects, adaptive quality, throttled shadows
commits.author: venturinodino-creator

commits.msg: Rework rendering: ambient occlusion, bloom, depth blur, contact shadows and glossier materials
commits.author: venturinodino-creator

commits.msg: Give the agent characters a fuller outfit, helmet visor and shoulder-pivot arms
commits.author: venturinodino-creator

commits.msg: Add procedural textures and finer detail to buildings and workers
commits.author: venturinodino-creator

commits.msg: Show at most five name tags, working agents first
commits.author: venturinodino-creator

commits.msg: Make the working people more visible up close
commits.author: venturinodino-creator

commits.msg: Collapse the activity feed by default
commits.author: venturinodino-creator

commits.msg: Frame the whole honeycomb beside the side panel
commits.author: venturinodino-creator

commits.msg: Pack islands like a honeycomb and make the workers visible
commits.author: venturinodino-creator

commits.msg: Restyle the 3D world to match the reference video
commits.author: venturinodino-creator

commits.msg: Rebuild the world in 3D: hexagon islands, glossy towers and robots
commits.author: venturinodino-creator

commits.msg: Describe the animation and replay in the README
commits.author: venturinodino-creator

commits.msg: Characters come alive and a replay keeps the world busy
commits.author: venturinodino-creator

commits.msg: A pixel-art world of rooms and characters from real agent data
commits.author: venturinodino-creator
